Class Location

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConwayLocation
public class Location extends Object implements Printable
Class representing a location in the game map. This includes keeping track of exits, character representation, terrain type, and other game data.

    • getItems

      public List<Item> getItems()
      Returns a list of items at this location.

      This list uses Collections.unmodifiableList() to prevent privacy leaks.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable List of items at this location

    • getItemsAs

      public <T> List<T> getItemsAs(Class<T> capability)
      Returns an unmodifiable list of all capabilities of the specified type provided by items at this location.

      For each item, attempts to retrieve the specified capability using asCapability. If the capability is present, it is included in the returned list. The returned list cannot be modified.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of capability to retrieve
      Parameters:
      capability - the class object representing the capability type
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list containing all capabilities of the specified type found among the items at this location; the list is empty if no items provide the capability

    • getGroundAs

      public <T> T getGroundAs(Class<T> capability)
      Returns the specified capability provided by the ground at this location, if available. Attempts to retrieve the capability from the ground using asCapability. If the ground does not support the requested capability, this method returns null.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of capability to retrieve
      Parameters:
      capability - the class object representing the capability type
      Returns:
      the capability provided by the ground, or null if not available

    • tick

      public void tick()
      Called once per turn, so that Locations can experience the passage time. If that's important to them. All items on this ground will also experience time.

    • canActorEnter

      public boolean canActorEnter(Actor actor)
      Returns true if an Actor can enter this location.

      Actors can enter a location if the terrain is passable and there isn't an Actor there already. Game rule. One actor per location.

      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor who might be moving
      Returns:
      true if the Actor can enter this location

    • getDisplayChar

      public char getDisplayChar()
      Returns the character to display for this location.

      If there is an Actor here, they are drawn. If there is no Actor, then any items present are drawn. If there is no Actor and no item, then the ground symbol is drawn.

      Specified by:
      getDisplayChar in interface Printable
      Returns:
      the symbol to draw for this location

    • getNearbyLocations

      public List<Location> getNearbyLocations(int radius)
      Returns a list of locations within the specified radius of this location. The list includes all locations in the square area around this location, excluding the current location itself. The radius is measured in map units.
      Parameters:
      radius - the distance from this location to search for nearby locations
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list of locations within the given radius, not including this location
